Spiritual Legacy

What is Agastya Nadi Jyotish?

Agastya Nadi Jyotish is an ancient system of astrology preserved on dried palm leaves (Olai Chuvadi) written by Maharishi Agastya in Vaitheeswaran Koil, Tamil Nadu.

📜

Ancient Tamil Manuscripts

Written in poetic ancient Tamil, the manuscripts contain detailed insights into past karmas, present obstacles, and future destiny predictions.

👍

Thumb Impression Matching

Every human thumb impression is categorized into 108 micro-patterns. Your right (male) or left (female) thumb impression locates your bundle.

🌐

Global Online Consultation

Connect directly from Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, or overseas. High-definition video call with real-time translation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to Your Nadi Astrology Questions

Agastya Nadi Jyotish (also written as Agasthiya Nadi Jyothisham) is an ancient predictive science authored by Sage Agastya. The predictions are inscribed on palm leaves stored predominantly at Vaitheeswaran Koil in Tamil Nadu.

You send your thumb impression digitally. Our Nadi readers in Vaitheeswaran Koil search the physical leaf bundles. Once matched, the reading and verification session is conducted live via video call.

Authentic Nadi readings are remarkably precise when the exact leaf manuscript written for your soul is located. Verification questions confirm identity before any predictions are read.

Only your thumb impression (Right thumb for males, Left thumb for females). Your exact birth time or horoscope is not mandatory, as the leaf reveals your birth details.

Kandams are specialized chapters covering different life aspects such as General Future (Kandam 1), Education & Wealth (Kandam 2), Marriage (Kandam 7), Profession (Kandam 10), and Remedial Measures (Kandams 13 & 14).
